description: Verifies shoppers can order without registering, while customers who want an account can create one or sign in again for profile and wallet features.
steps: Open the marketplace and browse the approved product catalogue
Sign in as a customer and open My wallet
Enter a top-up amount and select Paystack; verify the hosted payment page opens and no wallet credit is applied before server-side verification
Complete a successful Paystack test payment and verify the wallet balance and transaction history update exactly once
Repeat with manual bank transfer and verify the top-up is pending and not spendable until the owner confirms the received transfer
Refresh wallet status and verify the top-up history shows pending or completed status
Request a customer bank withdrawal with valid bank details and verify the wallet reserves the amount plus fee and the request appears as pending
Sign in as the owner, approve the customer withdrawal, mark the manual transfer paid, and verify the customer sees paid status
For a separate pending customer withdrawal, reject it and verify the reserved amount and fee are returned exactly once
Sign in as an approved vendor and verify the separate vendor sales withdrawal workflow remains available
Add an available product to the cart and adjust quantity
Apply a valid vendor coupon and verify the coupon savings reduce the checkout total
Try an expired coupon and verify checkout rejects it without creating an order
Continue as a guest, enter name and phone, leave email blank, select manual bank transfer and place the order
Verify the guest order is saved and the transfer instructions display without requiring registration

For a separate Paystack checkout, enter a standard valid email address (including one with accidental surrounding spaces), complete hosted payment, and verify it reaches Paystack instead of failing email validation
Use Create account or Sign in to open the secure account screen, then return later and restore the customer session
Open Help & Support and ask a common refund or order question to receive the support robot response
Send an unrecognized question and verify it is escalated to the admin inbox; sign in as owner and reply
Open a product and verify its star ratings and review comments are visible; submit a review only after a paid completed purchase
Sign in as the customer, open My Orders and verify order items, quantities, prices, subtotal, fees, total, payment details, delivery contacts and order progress are displayed
Sign in as owner, open Customer wallet top-up requests, confirm a pending manual bank transfer and verify the customer wallet balance and transaction history are credited exactly once
Reject a separate pending manual top-up and verify no wallet credit is applied
Use Manually fund a customer wallet to select a customer and add a custom amount; verify the wallet ledger records the owner credit
Cancel an unpaid New order and verify it becomes Cancelled and stock is restored
Verify Paystack status reports TEST MODE for a valid sk_test_ credential and LIVE MODE for a valid sk_live_ credential
Verify the customer is redirected to Paystack hosted checkout and the backend verifies the returned transaction reference before marking the order paid
Repeat checkout with manual bank transfer selected and verify the Yakaji Digital Hub Moniepoint account instructions and order number are displayed
expected: Guests can place manual bank-transfer orders without registering; Paystack still requires an email and server verification. Signed-in customers can fund their wallet through verified Paystack payments or owner-confirmed manual transfers, see their top-up history, and spend the balance on marketplace purchases. Customers can request bank withdrawals from their wallet balance; the amount plus fee is reserved immediately, the owner must approve before marking paid, and rejected requests return the reserved funds exactly once. Customers can view order history and cancel unpaid New orders, restoring stock. Product ratings and reviews are saved and only verified paid completed customers can post. The support centre answers common questions with automated replies, escalates unknown questions to the owner inbox, supports admin replies and displays the WhatsApp and email contacts. Paystack test credentials are clearly identified as test mode and live credentials as live mode; test transactions are never described as real payments.
